controls.pre: pre-0004 server (0001-0003) with a persistent injected pool-init failure; one authenticated /ws held open
controls.action: poll /health (4s timeout) while the /ws socket stays open
controls.expect_req: the inline fallback pins the accept thread, so /health times out until the pump exits
controls.actual: REPRODUCED: /ws served 101 by the inline fallback; /health stalled 4004ms (timeout) after 0 ok probes
controls.note: negative control on the PRE-REPAIR server: PASS means the source-identified starvation defect is real and reproducible

controls.expect_req: ws=false and wsReason naming the unavailable worker pool
controls.note: the UI must not be told ws=true while /ws answers 503

controls.expect_req: every attempt 503 with the truthful body; never a 101
controls.note: bounded refusal with the reason, never a silent disable and never an inline pump

controls.pre: persistent injected pool-init failure; /ws attempts interleaved with /health probes
controls.action: GET /health immediately after each refused /ws attempt
controls.note: the pre-0004 fallback pinned the accept thread here; the repair must not

controls.pre: transient injected pool-init failure (first init only); retry window 5s
controls.action: first /ws attempt, wait 9000ms, second /ws attempt, GET /health
controls.expect_req: first 503; second 101; /health ws=true with no wsReason
controls.note: degraded state is bounded: a transient init failure must not pin /ws off for the process lifetime
